C9000334.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 334 (A smooth surface metric with no local isometric immersion in ℝ<sup>3</sup>.; papers: A Smooth Metric with No Local Isometric Immersion into Three-Space; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/334.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN.statement: Theorem A: a smooth positive metric on (-1,1)^2 has no smooth isometric immersion on any neighborhood of the origin.

C_HEIGHT.statement: An immersion height satisfies det(Hess_g z)=K det(g)(1-|dz|_g^2).

C_PRESCRIBE.statement: Lemma prescribe constructs a positive metric with a prescribed sufficiently small smooth curvature via f_XX=-K_0 f.

C_PATCH.statement: Proposition patch: metrics in U admitting no admissible height are residual.

C_CAP.statement: Proposition cap: uniform C8 admissible-height bounds and all-orders metric bounds on images of compact cap rectangles imply all-orders ordinary-coordinate height bounds there.

C_CAP_VERIFY.statement: Independent verification of the full uniform cap proposition under exactly its stated metric and admissibility hypotheses, not just of its algebraic identities.

C_FLOW.statement: The solution-dependent flow is uniformly bi-Lipschitz with bounded low derivatives, sufficient for ordinary-coordinate local Sobolev estimates without high chart derivatives.

C_DRIFT.statement: Lemma drift: Dq-P_zx q-P_zy=K_y G+O(K) with uniformly bounded remainder coefficient.

C_HIGH.statement: Lemma high-equation: for l>=8, u=partial_y^l z satisfies the stated mixed-type equation with L2-controlled remainder and C=(l+1)A_s+O_l(A).

C_GRADIENT.statement: Lemma gradient: for every compact lower-cap R0 there exist a larger compact R1 and a uniform constant controlling ||grad u||_L2(R0) by ||u||_L2(R1)+||Lu||_L2(R1), with no top-edge data.

C_GEOMETRY.statement: The lower-cap curvature zero set has a uniform escape margin -K_y+epsilon*t^2>0; the other three cutoff edges have uniformly positive curvature.

C_DIRECTED.statement: The directed multiplier is uniformly coercive on K<=c1*(b-s), with constants chosen in the order epsilon, lambda, c1.

C_ELLIPTIC.statement: A squared cutoff in K/(b-s) yields the weighted elliptic gradient estimate on K>=c1*(b-s), uniformly as b-s tends to zero.

C_EDGE.statement: All artificial-edge fluxes vanish individually for smooth u, and the final bound contains no uniform derivative trace norm there.

C_BOOTSTRAP.statement: Original-coordinate differentiation and tame products close the all-orders cap induction, recovering successive x derivatives without high flow-chart derivatives.

C_PROPAGATION.statement: Lemma propagation supplies all tangential derivatives of z,z_theta at both pulse edges.

C_PULSE_MOMENT.statement: The pulse forcing gives a nonzero order delta*tau^(1-N) moment while spatial errors are order delta^2*tau^(1-N) and endpoint moments negligible.

C_CATEGORY.statement: The bounded admissible-height classes are nowhere dense; Baire category gives the whole-patch obstruction.

C_DISK.statement: Lemma disk: a graph immersion of a negative-curvature disk with zero boundary curvature has nonzero rank-one second fundamental form at some boundary point.

C_CAP_ALGEBRA.statement: The universally quantified real scalar identities, quantitative quadratic coercivity and scaled Young implications, and natural-number derivative-count bounds declared in CapAudit in Main.lean hold. This subclaim does not assert a PDE estimate or cap regularity.

C_FREE_EDGE_GENERAL.statement: The full uniform free-edge L2-to-H1 estimate holds for the stated cap geometry with any fixed finite-type curvature x^(2m)-h(y), m>=1, drift C=mu*A_s+A*r for fixed mu>1/2, bounded zeroth-order term, and weights of any fixed exponent p>=4, under the precise low coefficient bounds in report.md section 3.

C_CAP_GENERAL.statement: For every fixed positive integer m, Proposition cap remains true with prescribed exterior curvature kappa*(x^(2m)-h(y)) and the otherwise identical metric, negative-box, admissibility, low-bound and all-orders metric hypotheses.

C_ASSEMBLY.statement: The two-level gluing and finite orientation net turn the patch obstruction into the smooth metric germ of Theorem A, with Euclidean full Taylor jet.
